title: Unit multiplicity where the mass ratio stays below 2
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep U n with weight μ := R.measure, W ⊆ U open, S ⊆ W an arbitrary set, and c₀ < 2 a real number. Suppose that for every x ∈ S there is t₀ > 0 with μ(B_t(x)) ≤ c₀·ω_n·tⁿ for all t ∈ (0, t₀). Here ω_n = unitBallVolume n, B_t(x) is the closed ball, and c₀ and tⁿ are entered via ENNReal.ofReal. Then R.mult x = 1 for μ-almost every x ∈ S.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W S : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (c₀ : ℝ), 0 < n → IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → S ⊆ W → c₀ < 2 → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), R.measure (closedBall x t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c₀ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ S → R.mult x = 1
